# Introduction

Below is a code snippet that is extracted in the file `F79MA_Assignment.R`, with minor changes of adding additional line `set.seed(7830)` as to set seed for pseudo random number generator. 

```{r}
set.seed(7830)

RNGkind(sample.kind = "Rejection")
lambda0 <- 2
lambda1 <- 3
lambda2 <- 4
#
simulate_YA_YB <- function(n){ # n is the sample size
  set.seed(1234) ## Change this number
  X0 <- rpois(n,lambda0)
  X1 <- rpois(n,lambda1)
  X2 <- rpois(n,lambda2)
  YA <- X0 + X1 # sample of tremor numbers in zone A
  YB <- X0 + X2 # sample of tremor numbers in zone B
  return(list(YA = YA,YB = YB))
}
```
